name: Lunora
tagline: 自由组合玻璃信息胶囊、Duo 状态环与 mini Dock，打造完整状态栏体验。
description: iPhoneDuoIcon 正式更名为 Lunora · 月珞，带来全新图标与更完整的状态栏体验，升级会保留现有配置。
左侧玻璃信息胶囊与右侧 Duo 或 mini Dock 可独立设置并自由组合，显示时间日期、天气、媒体、音量、通知和 App 等内容。
提供统一屏幕定位、独立字体与配色、可选完全亮边和星环双动画，以及配置备份、更新引导、CPU 诊断与 Discord／QQ 反馈入口。
notice: 主包支持 iOS 15.1–26，不支持 iOS 15.0.x。建议使用原生刘海或灵动岛布局，支持已生效的原生刘海模拟；普通无刘海布局不保证显示效果。升级后请注销一次。iOS 26 已有用户测试反馈，但未覆盖所有设备与功能。与 SingleVPN 冲突。
features: 左侧信息胶囊与右侧 Duo 或 mini Dock 独立配置、自由组合
分区玻璃、圆形分区和一体玻璃三种信息胶囊样式
时间日期、天气、媒体、音量和通知等胶囊模块，支持左右滑动切换常驻模块
mini Dock 支持固定或最近使用 App、应用搜索和拖动排序，收藏应用不限制选择数量，实际显示按可用空间排列
mini Dock 可与星环共存，也可关闭星环仅保留 App Dock；支持独立位置调整并在星环展开时自动避让
通知 App 图标、内容滚动、点击跳转及从灵动岛或刘海区域展开的横幅动画
可隐藏系统音量条，并可选择横屏恢复原生音量条（默认开启）
支持 AM/PM 同行、上方或下方排列
左右显示统一以屏幕边缘定位，可调外侧边距、顶部距离、宽高与整体缩放，内部布局和线宽分别保留
双卡运营商常驻、自定义文字与双行显示
时间、日期和运营商支持系统字体或已安装自定义字体，可搜索、预览和选择
除天气与温度外，各模块可独立隐藏图标
右侧网络区域支持自定义文字、字号和位置，自定义配色可沿用 VPN 着色
灵动岛避让支持隐藏或横向收窄；左右可分别保留文字／图标，或选择仅文字滚动／在固定外框内整组滚动
锁屏显示原生右侧状态，解锁后收拢为胶囊或星环
岛内展开通知样式，并修正活动窗口判断导致的通知回退
优化小屏、锁屏和通知中心布局，并正确应用强制 12/24 小时设置
独立边框、模块图标与 VPN 指示颜色设置
点按滑杆数值可手动输入精确参数
天气与定位后台响应，保留缓存与刷新限频以减少界面卡顿
电池轮廓绕行动画支持用户配置的内部图标比例与信号间距
改善充电展开时的电池尺寸与媒体图标显示，并为左侧电池轮廓加入镜像充电效果
右侧胶囊、独立星环与 mini Dock 支持内置玻璃外观及独立材质透明度，右侧底色跟随左侧
统一 Wi-Fi、4G、5G 与 LTE 的视觉大小基准，并提供网络图标独立缩放
右侧时间支持字体与字重设置，时间、日期和运营商可加粗；扩大轮廓线宽与水平偏移范围
VPN 染色可保留蜂窝信号格或信号点原色
诊断导出与默认关闭的手动布局采集，便于反馈机型、设置和胶囊位置问题
设置主页提供 Discord 反馈入口及 QQ 交流群 1126594257，点击可复制群号
简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置界面
胶囊模式可选择不隐藏左侧系统时间
配置导入／导出带完整性校验，兼容旧配置并保留缺失的新设置
独立摆放日期、时间、星期及农历，分别设置字体、字号与文字方向
右侧胶囊支持多行文字、电池信息及上下行网速，方向标识可选箭头／三角，并可滚动、缩小或手动换行
mini Dock 自定义文件夹与图标大小，应用及文件夹可选圆形；合并系统状态图标并调整大小
玻璃边框原色及可选水珠动画，支持 50%–300% 幅度调节与即时预览
可调 Wi-Fi 线宽及 Wi-Fi／蜂窝显示强度
长按电池详情、面板箭头、触感反馈与电话助手电池长按兼容开关
提醒事项支持自然日范围、完成反馈与重复点击防护
系统状态图标可在左侧胶囊下方独立排列，支持对齐、独立缩放及上下位置调整
星环与胶囊网络图标支持独立上下与左右位置调整，mini Dock 沿用星环设置
左侧胶囊可关闭返回上一个 App 的显示，保持当前模块内容
未读通知铃铛可在锁屏后持续显示，直到对应通知已处理
星环左侧可显示信息，与胶囊分别保存文字、字体及多行排版；网速可与其他内容混排
系统图标分类筛选，点击胶囊可临时在独立图标行显示全部有效图标
新增左右文字随背景实时反色。
支持自定义时间格式；农历可选仅月份、仅日期或完整月日，中文使用汉字显示。
电池、Wi-Fi、蜂窝及双卡颜色支持独立选择“自动／自定义”；已用电量、未点亮蜂窝信号段和 Wi-Fi 弧线可分别透明。
mini Dock 新增应用角标、通知查看和系统长按快捷菜单。
文件夹支持网格、扇形、列表及 Apple Watch 样式；扇形支持上下全屏、展开／收起动画和点击空白收起。
内部图标位置可单独微调，mini Dock 星环支持左右偏移；左侧避让可选临时左移以保留宽度
新增解锁、收起控制中心后的恢复动画开关，并集中整理相关设置。
完善系统状态图标及刘海活动接入，改善 NiceBarX 图标重复、漏显和退出后的残留。
改善桌面与 App 的布局一致性、独立日期溢出显示及原生图标过渡显示，减少不必要的刷新
波形／频谱改用可选独立音频服务，缺少时提供安装指引。
支持 iOS 15.1–26 的原生刘海／灵动岛布局与已生效的刘海模拟；主包拒绝 iOS 15.0.x
两页更新与定位引导，说明新功能、整体定位及旧配置迁移，可在维护页重新查看
控制中心使用独立星环并自动跟随原生电池位置；桌面和 App 保留各自的右侧显示模式与整体定位
录屏、通话、导航与录音时，左胶囊保留内容并融合系统活动颜色和返回动作
每处液态玻璃可独立开启柔和的完全亮边，默认关闭
星环可选择原动画或先对齐再变形，mini Dock 内的星环共用动画模式
星环和胶囊可常显电池流光，选择系统／电量分级配色，独立控制充电流光及充电颜色
信号支持全部 SIM、仅 SIM 1 或仅 SIM 2，单卡信号均匀分布
mini Dock 可选关闭、上滑、下滑或双击联动一芽启动模式，普通点击保持原动作
可在通知中心滑动过渡时隐藏左胶囊，停稳后恢复，并减少不可见内容的刷新工作
手动录制 60 秒线程 CPU 信息与稀疏动态库线索，导出报告辅助排查卡顿和发热，不会自动上传
左侧分体玻璃按保留文字策略收窄时保持端部弧度
可选横屏停用 Lunora，恢复原生状态栏，回到竖屏自动恢复，保留已有配置
可选 Mikkyy 兼容，保护右侧显示和点击；与横屏停用均默认关闭
收藏 App 可统一设置仅有通知时显示，开启后可选择点击直接打开 App（默认）或查看通知小窗
mini Dock 可选跟随已加载且启用的微光角标样式；未安装、未启用或不兼容时保留普通角标
星环与旁侧自定义信息作为整体避让灵动岛，并沿用保留区域、滚动和隐藏策略
检测到启动失去响应后，下次启动暂停 Lunora 加载并保留配置，可在设置中手动允许重试
开启 CC 原生右侧图标和恢复动画时，常态内容等待原生交接与收回完成再恢复，mini Dock 图标不会提前覆盖原生图标
compatibility: 建议刘海／灵动岛布局，支持已生效的原生刘海模拟
usage: 安装时确认移除存在冲突的 SingleVPN；升级自 iPhoneDuoIcon 会保留原有配置。
进入“设置 → Lunora”开启总开关，再分别配置左侧信息胶囊与右侧 Duo 或 mini Dock；未保存总开关时默认为关闭。
建议在已生效的原生刘海／灵动岛布局下使用；普通无刘海布局不保证显示效果。iOS 15.0.x 不能安装主包。
选择胶囊玻璃样式与常驻模块，横向滑动可切换当前模块。
从 1.1.3 起，在“屏幕定位”中调整外侧边距、顶部距离、宽高及整体缩放；内部文字、图标与星环偏移继续单独设置，旧配置会自动换算并保留回退数据。
为时间、日期或运营商选择系统或已安装字体，并可搜索和预览。
按需设置灵动岛避让为隐藏或横向收窄，并选择保留区域、仅文字滚动或图标与文字整组滚动；也可开启锁屏原生右侧状态及岛内展开通知。
在 mini Dock 中选择收藏或最近使用 App，可搜索、排序和调整位置；收藏应用不限制选择数量，实际可见数量取决于空间，也可关闭星环仅保留 App Dock。
按需调整布局、配色与精确数值；设置修改即时生效。
遇到布局问题时可导出诊断或手动采集布局，并附机型、iOS 版本与复现步骤。
需要帮助时可通过设置主页的 Discord 入口反馈，或点击 QQ 交流群复制群号 1126594257。
在“维护与关于 → 配置备份”导出或导入配置；导入前会显示支持项数量，缺失项保留当前值，保存的总开关值也会应用。诊断报告不能作为配置导入。
需要电话助手电池长按时，先在电话助手启用对应功能，再开启 Lunora 的“兼容电池长按”；开启后暂停 Lunora 自己的电池详情长按。
在右侧胶囊内容中选择网速及上下行方向、箭头或三角标识；自定义配色时可选网络图标使用 VPN 着色。
在“交互与动画”开启水珠弹性动画并调整幅度，可预览当前可见胶囊；连续调整会合并预览，遵循系统减弱动态效果。
波形／频谱使用可选的 Banana Audio Service 1.0.4 或更新版本；未安装时可按提示前往 Banana 源手动安装。普通媒体信息和播放控制无需此依赖；服务重载需手动确认，期间声音会短暂中断。
在“状态图标与边框 → 系统图标显示”选择平时显示的图标及点击临时展开；在“交互与动画 → 控制中心”开启原生图标显示。
左右内容设置可分别开启文字随背景实时反色；自定义时间格式与农历月份／日期可分别选择。
每项颜色可独立选择自动或自定义；已用电量、未点亮蜂窝信号段和 Wi-Fi 弧线分别设置透明。
mini Dock 文件夹可选网格、扇形、列表或 Apple Watch 样式；扇形上下全屏展开，点击空白区域收起。
左侧避让可选择是否允许向左移动以保留宽度；解锁和收起控制中心后的恢复动画可分别开关。
在“右侧显示 → 星环展开动画”选择原动画或“先对齐，再变形”；mini Dock 内的星环使用同一选项。
每处液态玻璃的“完全亮边”可分别开启，默认关闭；电池设置可分别控制充电流光、常显流光和配色。
在 mini Dock 设置中选择一芽联动手势：关闭、上滑、下滑或双击。未安装或未启用一芽时保持原有行为。
在右侧网络设置中选择显示的 SIM；在维护页按需录制并导出 60 秒 CPU 诊断报告。
首次进入 1.1.4 设置会显示本次更新与定位说明；完成后不再自动重复，可在维护页重新打开。
在「设置 → Lunora → 运行与兼容」按需开启「横屏时停用 Lunora」或「Mikkyy 兼容」；两项默认关闭。Mikkyy 兼容不会在控制中心过渡、原生展开或主动隐藏时强制显示。
收藏通知显示、通知点击方式及跟随微光角标均在 mini Dock 设置中调整。通知点击方式仅在“仅有通知时显示”开启后显示，默认直接打开 App。
若设置提示启动失败保护已触发，先检查其他插件与系统状态，再在维护页允许下次启动并手动注销重试；已有配置保留。

changes: mini Dock 收藏应用取消数量上限，新增“仅有通知时显示”和通知点击方式选择，支持跟随微光角标样式。
改善桌面、App 与控制中心之间的显示和恢复动画，星环与旁侧信息整体避让；修复左胶囊偶发消失、内容恢复延迟及电量和充电颜色同步异常。
新增启动失败保护：检测到启动失去响应后暂停加载并保留配置，可在设置中手动恢复；完善诊断并减少不必要的刷新。
新增可选的「横屏时停用 Lunora」：横屏恢复原生状态栏，回到竖屏自动恢复，保留原有配置。
新增「Mikkyy 兼容」，保护右侧显示和点击。两项默认关闭，可在「运行与兼容」中开启。
新增两页更新与定位说明；统一左右整体屏幕定位，保留内部布局并自动迁移旧设置，控制中心可跟随原生电池位置。
新增可选完全亮边、星环双动画模式、电池流光常显与充电配色、双卡信号选择，以及 mini Dock 一芽分屏手势联动。
完善刘海活动颜色、文字布局和避让显示，减少重复刷新；新增 60 秒 CPU 诊断。主包最低支持 iOS 15.1，阻止 iOS 15.0.x 安装。
新增 iOS 15 原生刘海状态栏适配，支持已生效的原生刘海模拟。
优化启动稳定性，修复部分设备更新状态栏时的崩溃。
新增启用前兼容性检查与提示，未支持的布局保持原生显示。
新增左右文字实时反色、自定义时间和三种农历格式；电池、Wi-Fi、蜂窝及双卡可独立选自动／自定义颜色，已用电量、未亮蜂窝段和 Wi-Fi 弧线分别透明。
mini Dock 新增角标、通知查看及系统长按菜单；文件夹支持网格、扇形、列表和 Apple Watch 样式，扇形上下全屏并支持展开／收起动画和空白收起。
扩大右侧胶囊／星环位置范围，新增左移保宽及解锁／收起 CC 恢复动画选项；完善状态图标、刘海活动和 NiceBarX 兼容，改善定位、宽刘海、时间／运营商露出、天气恢复及面板刷新；波形／频谱改为可选独立音频服务。
音乐新增跟随音频变化的多种波形样式，并提供音频服务重载入口；未读通知铃铛可在锁屏后继续保留。
星环支持左侧信息，与胶囊分别保存内容和文字样式；网速可融入自定义多行文本，修复自定义配色下的 VPN 着色，左右收窄新增仅文字滚动。
系统图标可分类筛选，点击胶囊可临时显示全部有效图标；修复静音刷新、定位短闪及静音消失时的胶囊移位。新增控制中心原生图标选项，收回后动画恢复星环或胶囊。
右侧胶囊新增上行／下行／上下行网速，方向标识可选箭头或三角；自定义配色可让网络图标沿用 VPN 着色，优化星环与胶囊展开时的网络图标尺寸衔接。
左右胶囊支持收窄后图标与文字整组滚动；水珠动画新增 50%–300% 幅度调节与预览。mini Dock 应用及文件夹可选圆形图标，并新增默认开启的横屏恢复系统音量条选项。
改善静音及组合状态图标的重复显示与刷新延迟，包括开启“不隐藏左侧时间”的场景；减少音量调节及下拉通知栏时的卡顿。
修复左侧胶囊在桌面与 App 间宽度不一致及上下跳动问题；修正合并图标缩放，单个图标不再受影响，多图在避让时也能按设置放大。
新增星环与胶囊网络图标左右位移，mini Dock 沿用星环设置；统一左右胶囊的圆角曲线。
新增“显示返回上一个 App”开关，可保持当前模块显示；修复 iOS 16 控制中心在未开启隐藏 VPN 时仍不显示 VPN 的问题。
新增胶囊下方独立系统图标排，支持对齐、大小和上下位置设置；修复合并显示时模式图标重复。
新增星环与胶囊网络图标上下位置调节，mini Dock 沿用星环设置；改善文件夹缩略图在外观和应用图标变化后的刷新。
修正部分卡贴设备的单／双信号识别，改善左侧胶囊在桌面与 App 间的宽度一致性及两侧文字颜色同步。
扩展胶囊内容与排版：日期、时间、星期及农历可独立设置字体、方向和位置；右侧支持自定义多行文字与电池信息，可选择滚动、缩小或手动换行。
扩展 mini Dock 文件夹与图标大小、合并状态图标及缩放、Wi-Fi 线宽和信号强度显示设置；新增尽量占满空间、玻璃边框原色及可选水珠动画，完善收窄避让与信号动画。
提醒事项支持自然日范围、完成反馈与防重复点击；新增电池详情、面板箭头、触感反馈及电话助手电池长按兼容开关，并开放 iOS 15 测试安装。
修正总开关及左侧开关关闭后仍干扰原生显示的问题；首次安装默认关闭，保留明确保存的开关值。
胶囊模式新增“不隐藏左侧时间”，可按需保留原生时间，星环模式不变。
新增配置导入导出，使用 Base64 包装与完整性校验；兼容旧配置，缺失项保留当前设置，损坏文件拒绝导入。
重新整理左右设置与灵动岛避让，可隐藏或横向收窄并分别保留文字区或图标区；同时优化桌面、App、锁屏与控制中心之间的位置衔接。
完善玻璃材质、mini Dock 与状态图标：mini Dock 最多支持 8 个 App 且可关闭星环，并扩展材质透明度、网络、字体、线宽、充电及 VPN 显示调节。
新增诊断导出、手动布局采集及 QQ 群 1126594257 点击复制；放宽安装与运行至 iOS 26。本版为公开测试，部分机型与第三方灵动岛兼容性仍需反馈。
新增左右胶囊独立宽高/线宽、双卡运营商文字、系统/自定义字体及右侧网络文字设置。
新增模块图标隐藏、主页灵动岛避让、锁屏原生右侧状态和“岛内展开”通知，并修复通知回退。
恢复电池轮廓绕行动画，优化手动尺寸下的文字、描边、信号间距、充电展开与媒体图标；最低支持 iOS 16。
iPhoneDuoIcon 正式更名为 Lunora · 月珞，升级保留现有配置；左侧信息胶囊与右侧 Duo／mini Dock 可独立组合。
新增多种玻璃信息胶囊、mini Dock、通知与音量模块，支持常驻模块切换、App 搜索排序及通知交互动画。
扩展布局、配色与精确数值设置，优化小屏/锁屏、12/24 小时和天气响应，并新增 Discord 反馈入口。
新增独立 VPN 图标隐藏开关，与 VPN 着色分开控制，并改善系统 VPN 显示兼容性。
自定义配色可自动适应深浅背景；充电时可选用系统电池颜色，拔电后恢复自定义颜色。
胶囊左侧新增可预览、校验格式的日期，并优化日期排版、动画及与其他插件共用时的显示。
新增沿电池轮廓循环的充电流光，高亮头部搭配渐隐拖尾。
充电流光支持自定义电池颜色，并保留真实电量比例与数字缺口。
优化动画流畅度，修复可能遮挡其他状态栏图标的问题。
星环与胶囊新增独立隐藏 AM/PM 开关，仅在 12 小时制下生效；24 小时制时自动禁用。
优化 Wi-Fi、电量轮廓、信号点线和顶部电量数字，并为胶囊顶部数字新增独立缩放与重置。
调整动画节奏：星环展开/合拢约 3 秒，胶囊约 4 秒，原生图标继续停留 3 秒。
新增独立配色：电池、Wi-Fi、5G/LTE、卡 1/卡 2 信号可分别设色并同步动画；启用后不再被系统状态颜色覆盖。
星环与胶囊均支持独立大小、水平/垂直位置调节，默认居中并支持一键重置。
新增颜色重置为默认绿色，并优化星环顶部电量数字缩放、宽度与圆弧间距。
新增星环整体大小、水平/垂直偏移与顶部电量独立缩放，默认保持居中。
星环与胶囊专属设置仅按当前样式显示，所有调整即时生效。
优化百分比数字宽度并减少对其他状态栏图标的影响；VPN 与定位兼容性仍需实机复测。
新增共用电量百分比开关，同时控制星环和胶囊；星环支持左侧或顶部缺口位置。
胶囊数字固定顶部，关闭数字时自动补齐轮廓，并隐藏不适用的位置选项。
设置修改即时生效，并兼容旧版开关保存值。
优化展开后原生电池的电量同步，修复偶发显示红色 1% 或缺失电量的问题。
展开交接时及时刷新电池状态，同时保持真实低电量、充电及低电量模式的正确显示。
新增星环左侧电量百分比开关，默认关闭、即时生效，字体跟随系统样式。
重做电池、信号与 Wi-Fi 展开动画，加入边界绕行、错峰曲线与轻微回弹，并保留双卡独立信号和 3 秒停留。
优化小屏胶囊显示与自动刘海避让，空间不足时等比缩小，空间充足时保持原尺寸。
新增自动刘海避让，根据状态栏可用空间调整胶囊大小；空间不足时等比缩小。
优化小屏设备的右侧定位、时间基线、点击区域与展开动画，避免内容被刘海遮挡。
保留右侧留白调节，并更新简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置说明。
新增“星环 / 胶囊”样式；胶囊整合时间、电量百分比与网络状态，并支持双卡独立分段信号。
优化单卡电量轮廓、时间字号与基线、Wi-Fi / 5G 间距，并修复 iOS 16 胶囊显示问题。
设置修改即时生效，新增手动重新加载 SpringBoard 与 0–20 pt 右侧留白调节。
新增 iOS 16 适配。
新增点击展开：组合图标可动画展开系统原生的蜂窝信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标，3 秒后自动合拢。
优化原生图标的位置与尺寸衔接，减少动画结束时的跳动和生硬切换。
支持再次点击延长停留，并改善动画中断体验及三语言操作提示。
新增电量、Wi-Fi 与蜂窝信号三合一圆形状态栏图标。
支持单卡 4 点与双卡左右独立信号显示，并提供 VPN、充电及低电量模式状态提示。
新增启用开关、圆角设置图标，以及简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置。

en.name: Lunora
en.tagline: Freely combine a glass information capsule, Duo status ring, and mini Dock for a complete status bar experience.
description: iPhoneDuoIcon is now Lunora, with a new icon and a more complete status bar experience. Existing settings are preserved during the upgrade.
Configure the left glass information capsule separately from the right Duo or mini Dock, combining time and date, weather, media, volume, notifications, apps, and more.

Unified screen-edge positioning, independent fonts and colors, optional full-edge highlights and two Orbit animations, configuration backups, an update guide, CPU diagnostics, and Discord/QQ feedback entries.
en.notice: The main package supports iOS 15.1–26 and does not support iOS 15.0.x. Native notch or Dynamic Island layouts are recommended; active native notch simulation is supported. Display behavior on ordinary non-notch layouts is not guaranteed. Respring once after upgrading. Users have reported testing on iOS 26, but not every device and feature is covered. Conflicts with SingleVPN.
features: Independent left information capsule and right Duo or mini Dock configurations
Split Glass, Circular Partition, and Continuous Glass capsule styles
Time and date, weather, media, volume, notification, and other capsule modules with horizontal resting-module switching
mini Dock supports pinned or recent apps, search and drag sorting. Favorites have no selection cap; visible icons fit the available space.
Use mini Dock alongside Orbit, or disable Orbit for an apps-only Dock, with independent positioning and automatic avoidance during Orbit expansion
Notification app icons, scrolling content, tap-to-open actions, and banners expanding from the Dynamic Island or notch
Hide the system volume HUD, with optional landscape restoration enabled by default
Inline, above, or below AM/PM placement
Unified screen-edge positioning with outer-edge spacing, top distance, width, height and overall scale; internal layout and outline width remain independent
Persistent dual-SIM carrier display with custom text and two-line layout
System or installed custom fonts for time, date, and carrier text, with search and preview
Optional icon hiding for every module except Weather and Temperature
Custom right-side network text, font size and position, with optional VPN tint for custom network colors
Dynamic Island avoidance can hide or narrow capsules, with independent area retention, text-only scrolling or whole-content scrolling inside a fixed shell
Native right-side status on the Lock Screen, collapsing into Capsule or Orbit after unlocking
In-Island notification expansion style with improved notification fallback behavior
Improved compact, Lock Screen, and Notification Center layouts with correct forced 12/24-hour behavior
Independent border, module-icon, and VPN-indicator colors
Tap slider values to enter exact numbers
Responsive background weather and location work with cached data and refresh limits
Battery-outline traversal animation respects configured internal icon sizes and signal spacing
Improved battery sizing during charging expansion and media icon display, plus a mirrored charging effect on the left battery outline
Built-in glass appearance and independent material opacity for the right Capsule, standalone Orbit, and mini Dock, with right-side fill following the left
Unified visual sizing for Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G, and LTE, with independent regular network-icon scaling
Font and weight controls for the right clock, bold options for time, date, and carrier, and wider outline-width and horizontal-offset ranges
Option to preserve cellular strength bars or dots when VPN tinting is enabled
Diagnostic export and optional manual layout recording for device, settings, and capsule-position reports
Discord feedback entry and QQ group 1126594257 on the main Settings page, with tap-to-copy
Settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
Optionally keep the native left-side time visible in Capsule mode
Configuration import/export with integrity checks, older-file compatibility, and preservation of missing settings
Independent date, time, weekday and lunar-date placement, fonts, sizes and text directions
Multiline right-capsule text, battery information and upload/download rates with arrow or triangle markers, scrolling, shrinking or manual line breaks
Custom mini Dock folders and icon sizing, optional round app/folder icons, and merged system status icons with scaling
Original-color glass outlines and optional water-drop motion with 50–300% amplitude and preview
Adjustable Wi-Fi stroke width and displayed Wi-Fi/cellular strength
Battery details on long press, panel arrows, haptics and optional CallAssist battery long-press compatibility
Calendar-day reminder ranges, completion feedback and duplicate-tap protection
Show a separate system status-icon row below the left capsule with alignment, independent size, and vertical position controls
Adjust network icons horizontally and vertically in Orbit and Capsule; mini Dock uses the Orbit setting
Optionally hide Return to Previous App in the left capsule and keep the current module visible
An optional unread-notification bell remains after locking until corresponding notifications are handled
Optional content to the left of Orbit, with separate text, font and multiline settings from Capsule; network rates can be mixed with other fields
Filter system icons by type and temporarily show all active icons in a separate row when tapping the capsule
Added live background-based text inversion for both capsules.
Added custom time formats and lunar date options for month only, day only, or month and day, with Chinese character formatting.

Added independent Automatic/Custom colors for the battery, Wi-Fi, cellular and dual-SIM indicators, plus separate transparency options for the used battery track, inactive cellular segments and inactive Wi-Fi arcs.
Added app badges, notification viewing and native app shortcut menus to mini Dock.
Added Grid, Fan, List and Apple Watch folder styles. Fan folders support full-height expansion, opening/closing animations and tap-outside dismissal.
Adjust internal icon positions, move mini Dock’s Orbit left or right, and optionally allow temporary leftward movement to retain left-capsule width
Added separate capsule return-animation controls after unlocking and closing Control Center, with related settings grouped together.
Expanded system status icon and notch activity integration, and improved NiceBarX compatibility for duplicate, missing and lingering custom icons.
Improved layout consistency across Home Screen and apps, independent-date overflow and native-icon transitions, with less unnecessary refreshing
Audio waveforms and spectrum effects now use an optional standalone audio service, with installation guidance when it is missing.
Supports iOS 15.1–26 native notch/Dynamic Island layouts and active native notch simulation; the main package rejects iOS 15.0.x
A two-page update and placement guide covers new features, group positioning and configuration migration, with replay from Maintenance
Control Center uses an independent Orbit anchored automatically to its native battery; Home Screen and apps retain their own display mode and group placement.
Keep left-capsule content while reflecting native recording, call, navigation and audio-recording colors and return actions
Optional soft full-edge highlights for each liquid-glass surface, off by default
Choose the original Orbit animation or Align First, Then Transform, shared with mini Dock’s Orbit
Always-on battery flow for Orbit and Capsule, system or battery-level colors, and independent charging-flow and charging-color controls
Show both SIMs, SIM 1 only or SIM 2 only, with a single SIM distributed evenly
Assign swipe up, swipe down or double tap in mini Dock to follow Iya Split’s launch mode, or leave integration off; ordinary taps retain their action
Optionally hide the left capsule during Notification Center gestures and restore it when settled, with less work for invisible content
Manually record 60 seconds of thread CPU usage with sparse library clues and export a report for stutter or heat investigations; nothing is uploaded automatically
Left Split Glass retains its end curvature when narrowed with the Keep Text strategy
Optionally disable Lunora in landscape, restore the native status bar and automatically resume in portrait while preserving saved settings
Optional Mikkyy compatibility protects the right display and taps; both new options are off by default
Optionally show all favorites only while notifications are present, with taps opening the app by default or an optional notification preview
Optionally follow a loaded and enabled AmbientBadge renderer; ordinary badges remain when it is missing, disabled or unsupported
Orbit and adjacent custom information avoid the island as one group, retaining area, scrolling and hiding policies
After a detected unresponsive startup, pause Lunora on the next startup while preserving settings, with manual retry from Settings
With native CC icons and return animation enabled, resting content waits for native handoff and collapse to finish; mini Dock icons do not cover native icons prematurely
compatibility: iOS 15.1–26 (the main package does not support iOS 15.0.x)
Native notch or Dynamic Island layouts recommended; active native notch simulation supported
usage: Confirm removal of the conflicting SingleVPN package during installation; upgrading from iPhoneDuoIcon preserves existing settings.
Open Settings → Lunora, enable the master switch, then configure the left information capsule and right Duo or mini Dock. An unsaved master switch defaults to off.
Use an active native notch or Dynamic Island layout for recommended results. Ordinary non-notch layouts are not guaranteed. The main package cannot be installed on iOS 15.0.x.
Choose a capsule glass style and resting module; swipe horizontally to switch the active module.

Since 1.1.3, use Screen Placement for outer-edge spacing, top distance, width, height and overall scale. Internal text, icon and Orbit offsets remain adjustable; old configurations migrate while retaining rollback data.
Choose system or installed fonts for time, date, and carrier text, with search and preview.

Choose hiding or horizontal narrowing for Dynamic Island avoidance, retaining a selected area or scrolling icons and text together; optionally enable native right-side Lock Screen status and In-Island notifications.
Select favorites or recent apps in mini Dock, then search, reorder and position them. Favorites have no selection cap; visible icons depend on available space. Disable Orbit for an apps-only Dock.
Adjust layouts, colors, and exact values as desired; settings changes apply immediately.
For layout issues, export diagnostics or record a manual layout and include the device model, iOS version, and reproduction steps.
Use the Discord entry for feedback, or tap the QQ group entry to copy 1126594257.

Use Maintenance and About → Configuration Backup to export or import settings. Imports show the supported-entry count, preserve missing values and apply the saved master switch. Diagnostic reports are not configuration files.
For CallAssist battery long presses, enable the corresponding CallAssist feature first, then enable Battery Long-Press Compatibility in Lunora. This suspends Lunora’s own battery-details long press.
Choose network rates, upload/download directions and arrow or triangle markers in right-capsule content. Custom network colors can optionally use VPN tint.
Enable Water-Drop Spring Animation under Interaction and Animation, then adjust amplitude to preview visible capsules. Rapid changes are combined; Reduce Motion is respected.

Waveforms and spectrum effects optionally use Banana Audio Service 1.0.4 or newer. Follow the missing-service guidance to install it manually from Banana. Media information and playback controls work without it; manually confirmed service reload briefly interrupts audio.
Choose icon filters and temporary expansion under Status Icons and Outline → System Icon Visibility. Enable native Control Center icons under Interaction and Animation → Control Center.
Enable live background-based text inversion separately in left and right content settings; choose a custom time format and lunar month/day display.
Select Automatic or Custom for each color independently; set transparency separately for the used battery track, inactive cellular segments and inactive Wi-Fi arcs.
Choose Grid, Fan, List or Apple Watch folder styles in mini Dock. Fan folders expand to full height and close when tapping outside.
Choose whether left-side avoidance may shift left to preserve width; independently control return animations after unlocking and closing Control Center.
Choose Current Animation or Align First, Then Transform under Right Display → Orbit Reveal Animation; mini Dock’s Orbit shares this option.
Enable Full Edge Highlight separately for each liquid-glass surface; it is off by default. Battery settings separately control charging flow, always-on flow and colors.
Choose Off, Swipe Up, Swipe Down or Double Tap for Iya Split integration in mini Dock settings. Behavior stays unchanged when Iya Split is unavailable or disabled.
Choose which SIM to display in right-side network settings. Record and export a 60-second CPU diagnostic report from Maintenance when needed.
The first Settings visit on 1.1.4 shows the update and placement guide. It stays dismissed after completion and can be reopened from Maintenance.

Open Settings → Lunora → Behavior and Compatibility to enable Disable Lunora in Landscape or Mikkyy Compatibility. Both are off by default. Mikkyy compatibility does not force visibility during Control Center transitions, native reveal or deliberate hiding.

Adjust notification-only favorites, notification tap behavior and Follow AmbientBadge Style in mini Dock settings. The notification-tap option appears only with notification-only favorites enabled and defaults to opening the app.
If Settings reports startup protection, check the system and other tweaks, then allow the next startup from Maintenance and manually reload SpringBoard to retry. Existing settings are preserved.

changes: Removed the selection limit for mini Dock favorites, added notification-only visibility and notification tap behavior, and added support for AmbientBadge styles.

Improved display and return animations across apps, Home Screen and Control Center. Orbit and adjacent info avoid the island together. Fixed left-capsule disappearance, delayed content recovery, and battery level and charging-color updates.

Added startup protection: after a detected unresponsive startup, Lunora pauses loading on the next startup while preserving settings, with manual recovery in Settings. Improved diagnostics and reduced unnecessary refreshes.
Added an optional Disable Lunora in Landscape setting: restore the native status bar in landscape and automatically resume Lunora in portrait, keeping saved settings.
Added Mikkyy Compatibility to protect the right display and taps. Both options are off by default and available under Behavior and Compatibility.
Added a two-page update and placement guide, unified screen-edge positioning for both displays, automatic migration with internal layouts preserved, and native battery anchoring in Control Center.
Added optional full-edge glass highlights, two Orbit animation modes, always-on battery flow and charging colors, SIM signal selection, and Iya Split gesture integration for mini Dock.
Improved notch activity colors, text layout and avoidance, and reduced unnecessary refreshes. Added 60-second CPU diagnostics. The main package requires iOS 15.1 or later and blocks iOS 15.0.x.
Added iOS 15 native notch status bar support, including active native notch simulation.
Improved startup stability and fixed crashes during status bar updates on some devices.
Added compatibility checks and guidance before enabling; unsupported layouts retain the native display.

Added live text inversion, custom time and three lunar formats; independent Auto/Custom colors for battery, Wi-Fi, cellular and dual SIM, plus separate transparency for the used battery track, inactive cellular segments and Wi-Fi arcs.

mini Dock adds badges, notification viewing and native long-press menus; folders offer Grid, Fan, List and Apple Watch styles, with full-height Fan expansion, opening/closing animations and tap-outside dismissal.

Expanded right positioning; added left-shift and unlock/CC return controls; improved status/notch activity, NiceBarX, positioning, wide notches, native clock/carrier hiding, weather and panel refresh; audio visuals now use an optional service.
Added multiple music waveform styles that follow real audio, plus an audio-service reload action. Unread notification bells can now remain after locking.

Orbit supports left-side content with separate content and font settings from Capsule. Network rates fit into custom multiline text. Fixed VPN tint with custom colors; both capsules can scroll text only when narrowed.

Filter system icons by type or tap to show all active icons. Fixed mute refresh, location flashes and capsule shifts when mute disappears. An option shows native icons in Control Center and animates back to Orbit or Capsule after dismissal.
Added right-capsule upload/download rates with arrow or triangle markers, plus VPN tint for custom network colors. Orbit and Capsule expansion now settles at native network-icon size.

Both capsules can scroll icons and text together when narrowed. Added 50–300% water-drop amplitude with preview, round mini Dock app/folder icons, and a landscape native volume HUD option enabled by default.
Improved mute and combined-icon deduplication and refresh, including with Do Not Hide Left Time enabled. Reduced stutter during volume changes and Notification Center gestures.
Fixed left capsule width differences and vertical jumps between the Home Screen and apps. Merged-icon scaling now leaves single icons unchanged and enlarges groups during avoidance.
Added horizontal network-icon positioning for Orbit and Capsule, with mini Dock using Orbit settings. Unified corner curves on both capsules.
Added a Show Return to Previous App switch to keep the current module visible. Fixed missing VPN indicators in iOS 16 Control Center when Hide VPN is off.
Added a separate status-icon row below the left capsule with alignment, size, and vertical position controls; fixed duplicate Focus icons in merged displays.
Added vertical network-icon controls for Orbit and Capsule, shared with mini Dock through Orbit settings; improved folder thumbnail updates after appearance or app icon changes.
Improved single/dual signal detection on some SIM-adapter devices, left capsule width consistency between the Home Screen and apps, and text color synchronization on both sides.

Customize date, time, weekday and lunar-date fonts, directions and positions separately. The right capsule supports multiline text and battery information, with scrolling, shrinking or manual line breaks.

Added mini Dock folders and icon sizing, merged status icons, Wi-Fi stroke width and signal-strength controls. Added fuller-space layouts, original-color glass outlines and optional water-drop motion; improved narrowing and signal animations.

Added calendar-day reminders, completion feedback and duplicate-tap protection, plus battery details, panel arrows, haptics and optional CallAssist battery long-press compatibility. iOS 15 installation is available for testing.
Fixed interference with native displays when the master or left-capsule switch is off. New installations default to off; explicitly saved switch values are preserved.
Added Do Not Hide Left Time for Capsule, allowing the native time to remain visible. Orbit is unchanged.
Added configuration import/export with Base64 wrapping and integrity checks. Older configurations are accepted, missing settings are preserved, and corrupt files are rejected.

Reorganized left and right settings and Dynamic Island avoidance, with Hide or Narrow Horizontally modes and independent text or icon retention; also improved positioning across the Home Screen, apps, Lock Screen, and Control Center.

Improved glass materials, mini Dock, and status icons: mini Dock now supports up to eight apps and an apps-only mode, with expanded material opacity, network, font, outline, charging, and VPN display controls.

Added diagnostic export, manual layout recording, and tap-to-copy for QQ group 1126594257; installation and runtime now allow iOS 26. This public testing release still needs feedback for some devices and third-party island compatibility.
Added independent left and right capsule size and line width, dual-SIM carrier text, system or custom fonts, and right-side network text controls.
Added module icon hiding, Home Screen Dynamic Island avoidance, native right-side Lock Screen status, and In-Island notifications, with improved notification fallback.
Restored the battery-outline animation and improved text, outlines, signal spacing, charging expansion, and media icons at custom sizes; minimum support is iOS 16.
iPhoneDuoIcon is now Lunora, preserving existing settings while allowing independent combinations of the left information capsule and right Duo or mini Dock.
Added multiple glass information capsule styles, mini Dock, notification and volume modules, resting-module switching, app search and sorting, and interactive notification animations.
Expanded layouts, colors, and exact numeric controls; improved compact and Lock Screen layouts, 12/24-hour handling, and weather responsiveness; and added Discord feedback.
Added a separate VPN icon hiding switch, independent of VPN coloring, and improved compatibility with the system VPN indicator.
Custom colors can adapt to light and dark backgrounds; optionally use the system battery color while charging and restore the custom color after unplugging.
Added a custom-formatted date to the left of Capsule with preview and validation, and improved date layout, animation, and display alongside other tweaks.
Added a looping charging highlight around the battery outline, with a bright head and fading trail.
The charging highlight supports custom battery colors while preserving the real charge level and percentage gap.
Improved animation smoothness and fixed an issue that could obscure other status bar icons.
Added independent Hide AM/PM switches for Orbit and Capsule, active only in 12-hour time and automatically disabled in 24-hour time.
Improved Wi-Fi, battery outlines, signal dots and lines, and top battery numbers, with independent scaling and reset for the Capsule top number.
Adjusted animation timing: Orbit unfolds and combines in about three seconds, Capsule in about four seconds, while native icons remain visible for three seconds.
Added independent colors for battery, Wi-Fi, 5G/LTE, SIM 1, and SIM 2 signals, synchronized with animations and protected from system status color overrides.
Orbit and Capsule now have independent size, horizontal, and vertical position controls, centered by default with one-tap reset.
Added color reset to the default green and improved top Orbit battery percentage scaling, digit width, and arc spacing.
Added Orbit size, horizontal and vertical offsets, centered by default, plus independent scaling for the top battery percentage.
Orbit- and Capsule-specific settings now appear only for the selected style, with all adjustments applied immediately.
Improved percentage digit width and reduced interference with other status bar icons; VPN and location compatibility still require device retesting.
Added a shared battery percentage switch for Orbit and Capsule; Orbit supports left-side or top-gap placement.
Capsule keeps the percentage at the top, completes its outline when numbers are hidden, and removes the unnecessary position option.
Settings changes apply immediately and remain compatible with values saved by earlier versions.
Improved native battery level synchronization after unfolding, fixing occasional red 1% or missing battery readings.
Battery status now refreshes during the unfold handoff while preserving accurate low-battery, charging, and Low Power Mode indicators.
Added an optional battery percentage to the left of Orbit, off by default and applied immediately with the system battery percentage font.
Redesigned battery, cellular, and Wi-Fi unfold animations with boundary-following motion, staggered curves, and subtle bounce, while retaining independent dual-SIM signals and the three-second hold.
Improved Capsule display and automatic notch avoidance on smaller screens, scaling proportionally when space is limited while preserving full size when space allows.
Added automatic notch avoidance that adjusts Capsule size to available status bar space and scales proportionally when space is limited.
Improved right-side positioning, the time baseline, tap area, and unfold animation on smaller screens to prevent content from being obscured by the notch.
Retained right-side spacing controls and updated the English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings descriptions.
Added Orbit and Capsule styles; Capsule combines time, battery percentage, and network status with independent segmented dual-SIM indicators.
Improved the single-line battery outline, time sizing and baseline, and Wi-Fi / 5G spacing, and fixed Capsule display on iOS 16.
Settings changes now apply immediately, with a manual Reload SpringBoard action and adjustable 0–20 pt right-side spacing.
Added support for iOS 16.
